topics.description: Recent investigations into child care fraud in Minnesota and Texas have brought attention to the issue. The Minnesota Department of Human Services is looking into allegations of fraud in the state's child care assistance program. In Texas, a report found little evidence of fraud in its child care spending.

The FBI is investigating various cases, including a robbery at a Wells Fargo bank and allegations of sexual misconduct at a federal prison camp. The FBI is also looking into the handling of 2020 ballots in Fulton County, Georgia.
